title: RAGRouter: Learning to Route Queries to Multiple Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
authors: Jiarui Zhang; Xiangyu Liu; Yong Hu; Chaoyue Niu; Fan Wu; Guihai Chen
why_relevant: Proposes a router selecting among multiple LLMs for RAG queries; touches on heterogeneous RAG capabilities but does not study robustness, conflict, noise, or calibration directly.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on multi-LLM routing for performance, not on unreliable evidence, conflict handling, or abstention/calibration.
